# Graph-semantics owner dispositions

Reference v0.14.0/6f87158d77f6; working parent bc290f9.
This is a contract review, not an assertion that every source-inventory row
or every input has been certified. Final execution is recorded in results.md.

| Owner | Complete block inspected | Disposition |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Movement cleanup | uop/movement.py, all eight rules; src/uop/movement.c | Construction/order match; reuse existing exact eight-rule and empty-INDEX controls. No rewrite needed. |
| Weak lowering | uop/weak.py in full; src/uop/weak.c in full | Same commit/cast/lower ordering, default-width floor, comparison unification, cache and gated-index narrowing. Concrete C storage/default policy is already implemented. Renew only reviewed weak-module audit rows after their controls rerun. |
| Shape production | UOp._shape cases; src/shape.c compute_and_cache and cache publication | FUNCTION shape failure, PERMUTE/FLIP admission and symbolic flatten corrections in this batch. Existing BUFFER logical forms are an approved portable-storage boundary, not physical fallback. C rank/int64 allocation limits remain explicit. |
| Dtype production | dtype_from_uop and poly_dtype_from_uop/poly_rebuild_dtype | Forwarding UNSHARD dtype was missing. CONST/BUFFER/PARAM/CAST additionally use the explicit typed C constructors; no inferred Python-value constructor is claimed. GETADDR/PYLITERAL remain registered missing vocabulary. |
| Gradient construction | mixin/gradient.py; entire C reverse pass, shaped-edge repair, parameter compaction | Earlier root/tuple/reshape/COPY fixes retained. This batch fixes deviceless gradient inputs and failed compaction publication. Unsupported FUNCTION flags and UNSHARD backward remain failing capabilities, not allowances. |
| Substitution | UOp.substitute; C ordered opaque-body discovery and iterative shared memo | Current substitution intentionally follows replacement graphs and pins CALL/FUNCTION code bodies. Existing nested/deep/multiple-root controls cover those contracts. Compaction requires disjoint temporary slots and status-returning APIs; no new rewrite mode or scheduler was added. |

## Explicit remaining boundaries

- `call_gradient` precompile/precompile_backward combinations execute in pinned
  Tinygrad; C rejects them before gradient publication. Python's flags support
  forward execution only. `function(grad_fxn=...)` also rejects callbacks.
  Existing Tensor.custom_kernel/customKernel callback registries in Python/JS
  are a separate, implemented frontend boundary and are not evidence that
  FUNCTION callbacks work. No automatic support expansion is included here.
- UNSHARD shape/dtype representation is used by the core without requiring
  physical multiple-GPU execution. Its gradient rule calls shard in Tinygrad;
  C has no reverse-pass rule. Keep that with the multi-device debt, even though
  fixing shared dtype forwarding itself needs no accelerator.
- Tinygrad all_metadata propagates backward=True annotations on new gradient
  nodes. No equivalent shared C provenance store was found. This is missing
  diagnostic provenance, not proof of numerically wrong gradients. It is not
  silently marked not_applicable or approved.
- Resource bounds, symbolic arithmetic and rewrite-engine correctness retain
  their existing owner records; reading shape consumers is not recertifying
  every symbolic matcher. Index/range lowering belongs to group B. Residency
  collection and executable/codec ownership belong to group C.

The entire movement/weak source modules and the named shape/dtype/autograd
blocks were inspected together before the final checkpoint. Broad source
waves include other modules and overlapping file/class rows; these completed
blocks must be reused, not re-reviewed under each wave label.

Archbird overview completed with 360 files, 11,687 symbols, 192 warnings and
no errors; graph coverage remains incomplete (71 unknown/unsupported). It was
navigation evidence only. No static route was counted as execution.

Target/root seed, tuple NOOP accumulation and shape repair reviewed; backward provenance remains missing (PG-PARITY-030), and FUNCTION capabilities are partial. No whole-function equivalence claim.

Supported movement/reduction/COPY paths reviewed. UNSHARD backward is not implemented (PG-PARITY-013); opaque custom-kernel callback dispatch remains frontend-owned. No full matcher equivalence claim.

ADD/MAX/MUL source correspondence inspected with existing affected autograd controls. A standalone source-bound exact probe for every reduction-gradient branch remains required for whole-function certification.
